RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. A numerical probability would be guesswork.

Your qualifications warrant asking how you were assessed, but the announcement may omit relevant qualifications, leadership experience, or interview performance. Public consultation could also have been a key criterion.

Follow up in writing for the selection criteria, your assessment, and the reasons for the decision. Check applicable recruitment-review deadlines now; don’t assume awaiting a reply extends them.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
